def paged_search(query, sort_by='-updated_at', page_limit=20):

    i=0

        page=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token_note, query=query, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=sort_by)

import datetime, re

# Load exercise plan from Simple Note
note_pw = [c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
ns = apis.simple_note.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password=note_pw)
access_token_note = ns['access_token']
plan_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2544, access_token=access_token_note)
plan_text = plan_note['content']

now = datetime.datetime.now()
weekday = now.strftime('%A').lower()  # monday, tuesday...
print('now', now, 'weekday', weekday)

# Parse duration_mins for that day
# Simple regex: find 'day: <day>' block up to next 'day:'
pattern = r"day:\s*([a-zA-Z]+)\s*\n(.*?)(?=\nday:|\Z)"
matches = re.findall(pattern, plan_text, flags=re.S)
durations = {}
for day, block in matches:
    m = re.search(r"duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", block)
    if m:
        durations[day.strip().lower()] = int(m.group(1))

print('durations', durations)
workout_mins = durations.get(weekday)
print('workout_mins', workout_mins)

# Show pagination of playlist library to locate workout playlists
page_limit = 20

i=0

    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token_sp, query='', is_public=None, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    print('playlist_library page',i,'count',len(page) if page else None)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    i+=1

print('total playlist library',len(all_playlists))
# Filter titles containing workout-ish keywords
keywords = ['workout','gym','run','running','cardio','lift','lifting','strength','crossfit','hiit','training']
workout_cands=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    t=p.get('title','')
    tl=t.lower()
    if any(k in tl for k in keywords):
        workout_cands.append(p)

print('candidate workout playlists',len(workout_cands))
print('top candidates (id,title,songs_count from song_ids len):')

import datetime, re

# Determine today's workout duration from Simple Note (Exercise Plan)
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

# simple_note login

access_token_note = ns['access_token']
plan_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2544, access_token=access_token_note)
text = plan_note['content']

now = datetime.datetime.now()
weekday = now.strftime('%A').lower()
pattern = r"day:\s*([a-zA-Z]+)\s*\n(.*?)(?=\nday:|\Z)"
matches = re.findall(pattern, text, flags=re.S)
durations = {}
for day, block in matches:
    m = re.search(r"duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", block)
    if m:
        durations[day.strip().lower()] = int(m.group(1))
workout_mins = durations.get(weekday)
print('now', now, 'weekday', weekday, 'workout_mins', workout_mins)

# Spotify login and playlist library
sp = apis.spotify.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password=creds['spotify'])
access_token_sp = sp['access_token']

all_playlists=[]
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token_sp, query='', page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    print('library page', i, 'count', len(page) if page else None)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    i+=1

print('total playlists', len(all_playlists))
for p in all_playlists:
    print('playlist', p['playlist_id'], p['title'], 'tracks', len(p.get('song_ids',[])))

# Choose candidate playlists by total duration
threshold_seconds = workout_mins * 60
print('threshold_seconds', threshold_seconds)

playlist_durations=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token_sp)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_dur = sum(s.get('duration',0) or 0 for s in songs)
    playlist_durations.append((total_dur, pid, pl['title'], len(songs)))
    print('playlist duration', pl['title'], 'pid', pid, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_duration', total_dur)

# Filter those meeting threshold
meets=[x for x in playlist_durations if x[0] >= threshold_seconds]
print('playlists meeting threshold:', len(meets))
for x in sorted(meets, key=lambda t: (t[0], t[3])):
    print('meet', x)

if meets:
    chosen = sorted(meets, key=lambda t: (t[0], t[3]))[0]
else:
    chosen = sorted(playlist_durations, key=lambda t: (-t[0], -t[3]))[0]

chosen_seconds, chosen_pid, chosen_title, chosen_song_count = chosen
print('chosen', chosen_title, 'pid', chosen_pid, 'songs', chosen_song_count, 'seconds', chosen_seconds)
